searchText: I've created a PR to request adding `feeRecipientDiff` to the execution APIs: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/150 Do you all know if `engine_executePayloadV1` can be called on a historical block? Hi, https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/909752923234377738 so EL can decide how to compute payloadId, but I don't know more details. I know that Geth is generating a different payloadId than Nethermind I think this is pretty important to VC api for any block-builder schemes https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/179 [generally off this month on paternity leave so haven't been stewarding it, but I wanted to bring it to your attention]
